name: ecommerce-json-intelligence
title: E-Commerce JSON Intelligence (Shopify, WooCommerce, Schema.org Products & Prices)
description: Proxy-free e-commerce catalog & pricing scraper. Extracts products, variants, SKUs, inventory stock status, prices, and discounts via public JSON endpoints (Shopify /products.json, WooCommerce API) and JSON-LD Schema.org product feeds. Built for competitor monitoring and retail analytics.
